name: This_12
short_caption: The robot gestures with its left hand turned upward, as if presenting an option or indicating something nearby.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly raises its left arm, bending the elbow and rotating the forearm outwards to present an open, upward-facing hand toward its left side. Simultaneously, its head tilts slightly to follow the direction of the gesture. The robot holds this open-hand pose briefly before smoothly lowering its arm and returning its head to the upright, neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot's left arm sweeps outward to its left side; ensure there are no obstacles or people directly next to its left arm.
